articles.title: Rain is seeking a national trust bank charter to bypass third-party banks
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company’s proposed New York trust bank would custody digital assets and dollars, manage stablecoin reserves and issue and redeem dollar-backed tokens.

articles.title: Robinhood adds $25 million of bitcoin to its balance sheet
articles.snippet: Robinhood has added bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet, senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international, told the Starting Block Wednesday.
